requirements.label: FREN Elective
requirements.text: Complete 15 credits from among the following:

FREN 3030.title: French Composition and Conversation
FREN 3030.prereqText: ( FREN 2020G or instructor approval) and University Advanced Standing

FREN 3040.title: Introduction to Literary Genres in French
FREN 3040.prereqText: ( FREN 2020G or equivalent) and University Advanced Standing

FREN 3050.title: Advanced French
FREN 3050.prereqText: It is recommended that students take FR 2020G prior to enrolling in FR 3050. If you have advanced study of French, you may also contact the French Program Director for a placement test.

FREN 3200.title: Business French
FREN 3200.prereqText: ( FREN 3050 or equivalent knowledge) and University Advanced Standing

FREN 3610.title: French Literature to 1700
FREN 3610.prereqText: ( FREN 3050 or equivalent knowledge) and University Advanced Standing

FREN 3620.title: French Literature from 1700
FREN 3620.prereqText: ( FREN 3050 or equivalent knowledge) or department approval; University Advanced Standing

FREN 4200.title: Advanced Business French
FREN 4200.prereqText: ( FREN 3200 or equivalent knowledge) and University Advanced Standing

FREN 4900R.title: Special Topics in French
FREN 4900R.prereqText: ( FREN 2020G or instructor approval) and University Advanced Standing

LANG 3000.title: Language and Culture
LANG 3000.prereqText: ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 , ( ANTH 1010G or any foreign language 2010 course), Sophomore status, and University Advanced Standing

LANG 4200.title: Methods of Teaching a Foreign Language
LANG 4200.prereqText: (Matriculation into any secondary education bachelor degree program or departmental approval) and University Advanced Standing

LANG 4810R.title: Language Internship
LANG 4810R.prereqText: Departmental Approval and University Advanced Standing

LANG 4900R.title: Special Topics in Languages
LANG 4900R.prereqText: Department Approval and University Advanced Standing
